summary: FBRX 2.2.0 Beta (Weft): Fabrix learns skills, remembers you better and keeps more in mind; a space map for your drives, a Wi-Fi channel planner, screenshots you drag into any app, and FBRX Digger, the Network Center on its own.
notes: Skills: Fabrix knows how to do everyday jobs step by step (slow Wi-Fi, free up disk space, a slow computer, a security check-up, what's on your network, plan my day). After a bigger job it offers to keep how it did it, saved only when you approve; write your own in Settings → Skills.
The built-in model keeps more in mind: on Auto (the new default) its context window fits your computer, up to 64K tokens, and takes half the memory it did (8-bit with flash attention).

Memory finds things by what they are about (your Synology finds what you said about the NAS), learns how you like things done ("always answer in bullet points") and brings back related work from the last 30 days.
Fabrix shows its plan for bigger jobs as a checklist and ticks it off, checks its work before saying it is done, and asks one short question when a request could mean two things.

Storage → Space map: any folder or the whole drive as a map colored by kind of file. Click into folders, delete node_modules and build folders, move big files to the Trash, and clear caches, AI models and other space hogs in one click. Ultra: deep scans, duplicate files and what grew since last time.

Network Center → Wi-Fi: the channel planner draws every network around, shows how busy each channel is and tells you the best one for yours and why, with Open router settings. Ultra adds the channel width, DFS channels, channel history and every access point.
FBRX Snapshot: Drag out a marked-up picture straight into a chat, an email, a document or a folder.
Clipboard history keeps the pictures you copy, shows text exactly as copied (a password ending in |> no longer turns into an arrow), and W and S type into the search like any letter.

Security: updated components (the MCP SDK, nodemailer, systeminformation, zod, fastify and more), Electron 44.10.1, and the app's executable now refuses injected code and debuggers and checks its own files.
New: FBRX Digger 1.0, the Network Center on its own for Windows, macOS and Linux, on its own release (FBRX Digger 1.0.0).

server.summary: FBRX Server 1.3.0: the server's Fabrix gets FBRX OS 2.2.0's skills, memory, bigger context window and plans, with updated components.
notes: Fabrix on the server (the ai role): skills, better memory, the Auto context window, plans and checked work, as in FBRX OS 2.2.0.
Updated components: nodemailer 10, fastify, the MCP SDK, systeminformation and zod.
From 1.1: sudo fbrx-server update check, then sudo fbrx-server update commit.

command.summary: FBRX Command 2.2.0: updated components for security.
notes: Updated components: nodemailer 10 (email), fastify and the request parser, with fixes for the issues npm audit reported.

digger.summary: FBRX Digger 1.0: the FBRX Network Center on its own, every network tool included.
notes: Network scans and their comparison, ping and trace route, the speed test, the Wi-Fi channel planner, DNS and port checks, device consoles (SSH, Telnet) and network environments.
Runs next to FBRX OS without getting in its way: its own data folder, settings and no global shortcuts.
